title: Microplate Reader Operating Procedure
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7fkhjkw

steps.title: Power on and warm up
steps.instruction: Turn on the power and allow the device to warm up for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Initialize new process
steps.instruction: Open the program and select "New" to create a new process.

steps.title: Configure measurement settings
steps.instruction: Set the measurement mode and target wells.

substeps.instruction: Select the specific holes to be used according to the spotting hole (selected holes will turn blue on the 96-well plate schematic).
Insert the 96-well plate into the reader.

steps.title: Export and save data
steps.instruction: Retrieve the generated results and archive the data.

substeps.instruction: Wait for the system to generate the Excel file containing results and parameters.
Save and copy the file to a USB flash drive (u disk) for data processing.
